geography: United States (Adamas, then Supernus, net product sales)

approval_evidence.quote: NDA208944 GOCOVRI (AMANTADINE HYDROCHLORIDE), ORIG submission 1, submission_status AP, submission_status_date 20170824 (Drugs@FDA via openFDA)

launch_evidence.quote: We made GOCOVRI available for physician and patient use in the fourth quarter of 2017, and commenced the full commercial launch of GOCOVRI in January 2018.

unreported_quarters.2021Q4: Ownership change Adamas to Supernus. Supernus acquired Adamas on November 24, 2021 (Supernus 10-Q for March 31, 2022: 'On November 24, 2021, the Purchaser was merged with and into Adamas'); Adamas filed no report for the fourth quarter of 2021 (its last periodic report is the 10-Q for September 30, 2021), and Supernus's fourth-quarter 2021 release prints Gocovri $9.8 million covering only the period from the acquisition (footnote: 'Net product sales as of the acquisition of Adamas'), so no full-quarter figure is published.
